constitution.title: Constitution de la République algérienne démocratique et populaire, révision promulguée par le décret présidentiel n° 20-442 du 30 décembre 2020 (Journal officiel n° 82 du 30 décembre 2020)
constitution.publisher: Secrétariat général du Gouvernement, Journal officiel de la République algérienne (JORADP)
constitution.note: Arts. 85 and 88 (President by direct universal suffrage, absolute majority of votes cast, five-year term), 121 and 122 (APN by direct suffrage for five years; two thirds of the Council of the Nation elected indirectly, two seats per wilaya, by the members of the APC and APW, one third appointed; six-year term renewed by half every three years), 186 (six Constitutional Court members elected among professors of constitutional law, one each by the Supreme Court and the Council of State).

o21-01.title: Ordonnance n° 21-01 du 10 mars 2021 portant loi organique relative au régime électoral (Journal officiel n° 17 du 10 mars 2021)
o21-01.publisher: Secrétariat général du Gouvernement, Journal officiel de la République algérienne (JORADP)
o21-01.note: Art. 169 (APC and APW members elected for five years by open-list proportional representation with a preferential vote, without panachage, in the three months before the term ends), 191 (APN by the same system for five years), 217 and 218 (elected two thirds of the Council of the Nation for six years, renewed by half every three years, by single-round plurality vote at wilaya level by an electoral college of APC and APW members), 247 and 248 (President by a two-round absolute-majority vote; the top two meet in the runoff).

l84-09.note: Art. 3 sets the territorial organization at 48 wilayas and 1,541 communes. The scanned French issue has no text layer; Loi 19-12 and Loi 26-06 amend this same article.

classes.name: Élection des membres de l'Assemblée Populaire Nationale
classes.note: 407 members since 2021, elected for five years by open-list proportional representation with a preferential vote in each wilaya and in four zones abroad (Ordinance 21-01 art. 191; Ordinance 21-02). The sole chamber until 1997, the lower house since. A vacancy passes to the next candidate on the list, so there are no by-elections. Single-party lists (FLN) until 1987; the 1991 first round was annulled.

dates.note: First multiparty election, two-round single-member system; the second round set for 16 January 1992 was cancelled and the first-round results were annulled with the January 1992 interruption of the electoral process.

classes.name: Élection des deux tiers des membres du Conseil de la Nation
classes.name_en: Council of the Nation (elected two thirds)
classes.note: Two seats per wilaya elected for six years, half renewed every three years, by single-round plurality vote of an electoral college of the wilaya's APC and APW members (Constitution arts. 121 and 122; Ordinance 21-01 arts. 217 and 218). The other third is appointed by the President. The wilayas created in 2026 will first elect at the next renewal.

dates.note: First election of the Council of the Nation: both seats of each of the 48 wilayas. Proclamation n° 02-97/P.CC of 27 December 1997, Journal officiel n° 86, https://www.joradp.dz/FTP/jo-francais/1997/F1997086.pdf.
Half renewal; one seat in each of the 48 wilayas. Proclamation n° 01-P-CC-01 of 1 January 2001, Journal officiel n° 4 of 2001, https://www.joradp.dz/FTP/jo-francais/2001/F2001004.pdf.

Half renewal. The proclamation covers 46 wilayas and omits Béjaïa and Tizi Ouzou; the vote in El Bayadh was annulled and no later poll is printed, so 45 wilayas have a result. Proclamation n° 01/P-CC/04 of 4 January 2004, Journal officiel n° 5 of 2004, https://www.joradp.dz/FTP/jo-francais/2004/F2004005.pdf.

Half renewal. The votes in Djelfa and Constantine were annulled and repeated on 8 January 2007. Proclamation n° 01/P.CC/07 of 1 January 2007, Journal officiel n° 4 of 2007, https://www.joradp.dz/FTP/jo-francais/2007/F2007004.pdf.
Repeat poll in Djelfa and Constantine. Proclamation n° 02/P.CC/07 of 9 January 2007, Journal officiel n° 10 of 2007, https://www.joradp.dz/FTP/jo-francais/2007/F2007010.pdf.

Half renewal. The Ouargla result was annulled and the poll repeated on 13 January 2010. Proclamation n° 02/P.CC/09 of 31 December 2009, Journal officiel n° 6 of 2010, https://www.joradp.dz/FTP/jo-francais/2010/F2010006.pdf.
Repeat poll in Ouargla. Proclamation n° 01/P.CC/10 of 14 January 2010, Journal officiel n° 6 of 2010, https://www.joradp.dz/FTP/jo-francais/2010/F2010006.pdf.
Half renewal. Proclamation n° 01/P.CC/13 of 1 January 2013, Journal officiel n° 2 of 2013, https://www.joradp.dz/FTP/jo-francais/2013/F2013002.pdf.
Half renewal. Proclamation n° 01/P.CC/16 of 1 January 2016, Journal officiel n° 2 of 2016, https://www.joradp.dz/FTP/jo-francais/2016/F2016002.pdf.

Half renewal. The vote in Tlemcen was annulled and repeated on 10 January 2019. Proclamation n° 01/P.CC/19 of 4 January 2019, Journal officiel n° 5 of 2019, https://www.joradp.dz/FTP/jo-francais/2019/F2019005.pdf.
Repeat poll in Tlemcen. Proclamation n° 02/P.CC/19 of 14 January 2019, Journal officiel n° 9 of 2019, https://www.joradp.dz/FTP/jo-francais/2019/F2019009.pdf.

Half renewal; the ten wilayas created by Loi 19-12 elected both their seats. Proclamation n° 01/PCC/22 of 10 February 2022, Journal officiel n° 12 of 2022, https://www.joradp.dz/FTP/jo-francais/2022/F2022012.pdf.
Half renewal; the Constitutional Court proclaimed the result. Proclamation n° 01/P.C.C/25 of 13 March 2025, Journal officiel n° 19 of 2025, https://www.joradp.dz/FTP/jo-francais/2025/F2025019.pdf.

classes.note: Single national lists approved by plebiscite: the Constituent Assembly of 20 September 1962 and the National Assembly of 20 September 1964 under the 1963 Constitution. The Assembly ceased with the 19 June 1965 coup; no legislature sat until 1977.

classes.name: Assemblée algérienne
classes.note: Created by the French Statute of Algeria (law of 20 September 1947), elected by two separate colleges in 1948 and 1951, dissolved in 1956. The French-era Financial Delegations and Algeria's seats in the French parliament belong with it.
classes.disposition_reason: Elections held under French sovereignty before independence; they belong under France or a colonial polity if the archive adds one, and Algeria's Journal officiel does not cover them.

classes.name: Élection des membres de la Cour constitutionnelle parmi les professeurs de droit constitutionnel
classes.name_en: Constitutional Court members elected by professors of constitutional law
classes.note: Six of the twelve members are elected among professors of constitutional law, one by the Supreme Court and one by the Council of State (Constitution art. 186). The judges' own elections to the Conseil supérieur de la magistrature are of the same kind.
classes.disposition_reason: A professional electorate of a few hundred academics and judges, not a public election; no votes are published.
